purpose: UX-06/UX-38 T09/T24 verification-first: prove current About CTA and Trust-card geometry at real 200% text enlargement before any runtime repair.
ownerSpecification: Прозрачная Цена — инженерное ТЗ быстрого UX-ремонта v2.0, 23.09.2026, sections 4.1-4.4, UX-06/UX-38 and T09/T24.
coordination: Team Hub #5469 claim 5786260598. Test-only exact scope until browser evidence proves a runtime defect. Candidate b2ae7ae6 reproduced UX-38: Trust first card expanded to 453.42 CSS px on a 320px RU viewport and 387.98px on 320px EN under 200% text; About CTA cases passed. Runtime CSS admission is therefore evidence-driven. CORRECTION: the first 200% rule targeted both li and its child span, compounding percentage font sizing to 400% for list text. That evidence is invalid for UX-38. Runtime CSS repair is reverted; corrected leaf-text-only 200% acceptance must decide whether a current defect exists. Corrected 200% exact-head evidence on 5527733c leaves one RU/320 failure only: Decision description scrollWidth 226 vs clientWidth 224. All other Trust/locale/width cases and About CTA pass. Runtime admission is limited to +2px content width via 14px padding-inline at <=360px; no word breaking or overflow hiding. Exact head 6e7e44de still measured scrollWidth 226 vs clientWidth 224 for RU/320 at 200% text; 12px inline padding admitted for a further 4px of text space. Canonical Visual also encountered a mobile auth smoke failure, which remains open for independent root-cause check.
requiredInvariants: No runtime code changes are admitted until current-main browser evidence reproduces a defect.
Both About CTA controls are entirely inside the CSS viewport, retain at least 44x44 CSS-pixel targets, pass multiple elementFromPoint hit checks and do not clip at 320/375/390/430 in RU/EN/ZH.
All four Trust cards remain in the viewport horizontally with natural height and every visible text node remains unclipped at the same widths/locales.
The same checks are repeated after explicit 200-percent text enlargement to exercise reflow pressure.
Whole-document horizontal overflow remains at most one CSS pixel.
No acceptance threshold, retry, screenshot authority, application code, API, auth or production behavior changes.
At <=360px Trust pillar horizontal padding may reduce from 15px to 12px to resolve the measured 2px RU/200%-text overflow while preserving normal word wrapping and typography.
